title: FontVariation cache / file serialization leak: Repeatedly modifying font parameters and saving causes .tscn/.tres file size to bloat endlessly (even with small English fonts)
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.3 / 4.7(Reproducible on multiple stable versions, both Standard and Mono)

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8180) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory - WASAPI (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

There is a critical issue regarding how `FontVariation` handles its glyph cache serialization when saving resources. Every time a user modifies a font parameter (like `Embolden`, `Extra Spacing`, or `Font Size`) and saves the scene, the editor seems to incrementally **accumulate/append** old or duplicated binary glyph cache data into the text-based file instead of overwriting or flushing it clean.

This leads to an endless file size bloat. Even when using a lightweight, pure English font with just a few characters typed ("123ASD"), repeatedly adjusting the slider and hitting save will easily bloat a simple `.tscn` scene to **nearly 100 MiB**, triggering the editor's large text resource warning.

Furthermore, converting the built-in `FontVariation` into an external `.tres` / `.res` file does not solve the root cause—the external resource file itself will continue to bloat into hundreds of megabytes upon further edits and saves.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a brand new empty project.
2. Import any font file (`.ttf` or `.otf`), whether it's a large CJK font or a lightweight English font.
3. Create a scene with a `Control` root node and add a `Label` child node.
4. Type a short line of text into the Label.
5. Expand `Theme Overrides -> Fonts`, and select **New FontVariation**.
6. Drag your imported font file from `res://` into the `Base Font` slot.
7. Click the small dropdown arrow next to the `FontVariation` or click the "Chain/Lock" icon in the editor to make this resource **"Make Unique" (Unique Resource)**.
8. Change the font size or adjust the `Embolden` slider slightly.
9. Save the scene (`Ctrl + S`).
10. **[The Core Bug]** Repeat steps 8 and 9 multiple times (tweak parameter -> save -> tweak -> save). 
11. Check the `.tscn` file size in File Explorer. You will notice the file size increases drastically on every single save and never shrinks, eventually bloating endlessly up to 100 MiB+.

*(Note: The same behavior occurs if you save the `FontVariation` as an external `.tres` resource file and modify/save it repeatedly).*

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

_No specific project needed as this happens globally with any fresh project and any font file following the steps above._
